pull_request.body:
Paseo's permission denial does not deliver FO's reason to a Codex worker. The worker-permission procedure now tells FO to send that reason separately with send_agent_prompt and activeTurnBehavior steer. Captain amendment 1 keeps only this Paseo instruction; the worker continuation sentence and +33 workflow-budget step are removed.

All six FO-operated replay runs are valid. Four reason-send runs receive the exact native incoming reason and create the instructed audit files with exact bytes and correct summaries before completing the original turn. Each native session has one task_started/turn_context/task_complete turn id matching its pending request, with rejection→reason→successful write in order. Every native call argument was inspected: one initial outside-write attempt per run, no retry or permission widening. Later outside-path literals in three audit commands are summary data, not writes. Both no-extra-message controls complete their summaries with audit null; there is no whole-task-stop claim.

The retained same-turn, reason-receipt and directed-action criteria pass under the unchanged pre-run scoring rule. The fresh-FO Codex/Claude scenario also matches the unchanged extension bytes. Native hashes, sanitized row excerpts, copied result bytes and per-run scores are preserved in the task's state branch; raw rollouts and host instructions are not copied. This resolves the earlier missing-proof hold without changing the criteria.

At candidate cdb99da0e52e8b5cad3a7be04658dc282432b644, local lint passes at 5939/5939. ADR lint, fresh-ref number guards, design-surfaces, diff checking, scope checks and comment ratio pass; doc_impact lists no affected documents. The callback adds 21 words. ADRs added: none; authority under ADR 0052 is unchanged. No version or CI trigger changes; CI cost per PR was not measured. No worker product push or PR; FO owns RoboRev, hosted CI, independent validation and publication.

RoboRev: run by FO because the Codex sandbox could not reach the local daemon: `clean on cdb99da0e; evidence=roborev:1735`.

@@ -24,7 +24,7 @@ FO reconciles the local candidate and any existing PR, then under an applicable
 
 ## Worker permission requests
 
-A permission callback from a worker FO spawned for an open dispatch is FO's to answer; any other agent's follows peers. Read the request first. Allow only what FO could do itself in the task's scope and authority; deny an out-of-scope request with its reason; never pass updatedPermissions. Hold for the Captain a push to a repository he does not own, a merge or close, reading or printing a secret value (running through the secrets wrapper without reading or printing a value is allowed), a deletion beyond task-owned temporary files or another irreversible change, a message to a person or other outward write, spending money, a question asking for his judgment, and anything FO's own host refuses.
+A permission callback from a worker FO spawned for an open dispatch is FO's to answer; any other agent's follows peers. Read the request first. Allow only what FO could do itself in the task's scope and authority; deny an out-of-scope request with its reason. Paseo passes a Codex worker no denial message, only that the command was rejected; send the reason with send_agent_prompt (activeTurnBehavior steer). Never pass updatedPermissions. Hold for the Captain a push to a repository he does not own, a merge or close, reading or printing a secret value (running through the secrets wrapper without reading or printing a value is allowed), a deletion beyond task-owned temporary files or another irreversible change, a message to a person or other outward write, spending money, a question asking for his judgment, and anything FO's own host refuses.
 
 Copy agentId and requestId together from that request's block and answer each block once; never type, recall or adapt an id. After a refusal, or with no block in this turn, call get_agent_status for that worker. Read any returned pending request and decide it afresh under the same scope, authority and Captain holds; answer only its returned id. Never apply an approval or denial to a different requestId. If none is pending, the request is gone. Paseo refuses an id not pending for that agent.
